name: Liquid glass
fit: Refractive, reactive translucency (Apple-native feel; use sparingly on web).
feel: Fluid, premium, light bending through chrome.
surfaces: Translucent refractive panels on rich backdrops; solid content under glass chrome.
type: Clean system sans; high legibility on frosted bars.
color: Soft tints through glass; strong contrast on reading surfaces.
bestFor: Marketing shells, native-feeling mobile, hero chrome—not dense grids.
avoid: Frosted data tables, low-contrast body text on blur.
adapt: Reserve glass for chrome/overlays; keep product work areas solid.
